note: PLATE GATE of 8945 (Glossa ordinaria, Liber Deuteronomii, PL 113). Migne PL 113, scan Gallica ark:/12148/bpt6k5505319w (PL 113 second witness), IIIF native-resolution crops; page map f = ceil(column/2), CALIBRATED on f242 whose printed corner numbers read 483/484 (confirms the mapping stint 4 established for cols 482-492). 9 columns read this session (0445D, 0452A, 0454C, 0471C, 0476C, 0481A, 0481C, 0496C) to close every [sic:]/[var:] the five translation stints had fired without a plate read. RESULT: 3 CONFIRMED as Migne's own printing (0445D [var:], 0452A [sic: gui], 0454C [sic: Cabesbarne]); 6 REFUTED -- Corpus Corporum's own corruption, not Migne's, all in one tight span (0471C-0481C) plus 0496C. Combined with stint 4's own find at 0492B (pre->per, also corrupted), that is 7 CORRUPTED total in this work.
class: CORRUPTED -- Corpus Corporum broke a word Migne set correctly. Repaired here; no [sic:] marker may stand against Migne on the strength of any of these. The corresponding English chunks must be corrected to read the plain word with no marker.

patches.find:
operari. Sicque religiose coversans in mundo, qui
senario conditus est numero, post perfectionem bonorum
patches.replace:
operari. Sicque religiose conversans in mundo, qui
senario conditus est numero, post perfectionem bonorum
patches.why: Gallica f236 (pp.471/472), left column, band C, verified: 'Sicque religiose conversans in mundo, qui senario conditus est numero' -- a clean, unambiguous 'conversans' with the n present. CC dropped a letter. English's [sic: coversans] at 0471C (src/english/8945/0010.md) is WITHDRAWN; render plainly as 'living'.

patches.find:
unde: <hi>Dilatant phylacteria sua et magnificam
fimbrias.</hi>
patches.replace:
unde: <hi>Dilatant phylacteria sua et magnificant
fimbrias.</hi>
patches.why: Gallica f238 (pp.475/476), right column, band C, verified: 'Dilatant phylacteria sua et magnificant fimbrias' -- plural verb agreeing with 'phylacteria...dilatant', matching Matt. 23:5. CC produced the non-word 'magnificam'. English's [sic: magnificam] at 0476C (src/english/8945/0012.md) is WITHDRAWN; render plainly as 'and magnify their fringes'.
